title: Single SWF static inspection entry
description: Contract for one inspected SWF: header fields, tag inventory, symbol/export names, embedded asset IDs, and script presence recorded by static byte reads only. Nothing here is executed, rendered, or interpreted behaviorally.

path.description: Registry path of the inspected SWF file.

signature.description: SWF compression signature; CWS (zlib) and FWS (uncompressed) are accepted, anything else fails closed.

declared_length.description: File length declared in the header (recorded, never trusted).

actual_length.description: Measured worktree file size in bytes; walks are bounded by it.

frame_width.description: Stage width in pixels from the FrameSize rect.

frame_height.description: Stage height in pixels from the FrameSize rect.

frame_rate.description: Frame rate in frames per second from the 8.8 fixed field.

frame_count.description: Total frames declared in the header.

tags.description: Tag code inventory mapping decimal tag codes to occurrence counts, including tags nested inside DefineSprite timelines.

sprite_count.description: DefineSprite tag occurrences including nested ones.

max_sprite_depth.description: Maximum DefineSprite nesting depth reached (0 when no sprites nest further).

symbols.description: SymbolClass names recorded verbatim in tag order.

exports.description: ExportAssets names recorded verbatim in tag order.

bitmap_ids.description: Character IDs of embedded bitmap definitions (DefineBits family).

sound_ids.description: Character IDs of embedded sound definitions.

sound_formats.description: Sound format nibbles parallel to sound_ids.

has_abc.description: True when any DoABC tag is present (presence only, never executed).

has_action.description: True when any DoAction/DoInitAction tag is present (presence only).

frame_labels.description: FrameLabel names recorded verbatim in tag order.

scene_count.description: Scene count from DefineSceneAndFrameLabelData, or 0 when absent.
